paragraphs.text: Which was an instrument or king of note.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Whereas no regard is had for honesty or dishonesty, for virtue nor for vice, there the prophet pronounces that the people have no God.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: By which he condemns all knowledge and understanding that tends not to seek God.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: David pronounces God's vengeance against cruel governors who having charge to defend and preserve God's people, cruelly devour them.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: When they thought there was no opportunity to fear, the sudden vengeance of God lighted on them.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: No matter how great the enemies power is, or fearful the danger, yet God delivers his in due time.
paragraphs.label: f
